description: State-port registry (RFC-048 §12.6, RFC-049 §5). Ports are bytes 0–255. MSHS-2 (MASH) reserves the top band; no SAMESTATE range may span it. Bands may overlap across coin classes (ports are per-coin namespaces), never across the MSHS boundary.

mshsBand.notes: bundleBase = 256 - (4 + k) = 230 (k=22). Header R/ROOTS_BLOB/SECRETS_BLOB/TREE_SIG at 230-233; PROOF at 234-255. The node refuses any tx with state in 230..255.

bands.notes: channel/factory control (100 SETTLEMENT, 101 SEQUENCE, 102 COMMITMENT, 103 escape)
channel program ports (COUNTER 120-122, METER 130-133, HTLC 140-144, VAULT 150-152, TREASURY 160-164, MEMBERSHIP 170-172, ASSET 180-183)
per-party share band, base 128 (POOL_SHARE_PORT_BASE / FACTORY_BALANCE_PORT_BASE); capped below the MSHS floor 230 → max 102 parties

rules: R-MASH-1: MASH state lives only in the MSHS band (>= 230); no other package may allocate there.
R-MASH-2: Omnia variable-length bands (party shares) MUST be allocated below the MSHS floor (base 128).
R-MASH-3: No SAMESTATE range may span the MSHS band.
R-MASH-4: A composite (MASH + Omnia + MAST) transaction MUST publish a port-allocation table and pass an instruction-budget check.
R-MASH-5: Omnia scripts MUST NOT embed the full MASH verifier in the update path.
